'''Bunker Aleph-One''' was a base inside the [[Revos Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]]. It was where four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] were kept in constant readiness in case of an attack.<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

During [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Storinal|mission]] to the planet, they stole two of the bunker's TIE Fighters while destroying the other two.<ref name="WS" />
